audit.why: Even lane at 50.9% over 391 games; Quinn owns levels 1-3 with range and Harrier resets, Galio takes over at 6 with a global R.
audit.corrected: Kept the shape, corrected the level-6 row to Galio to match the packet chart and the existing why text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed with the packet and with whys[4] at Level 6.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180s at rank 1 but global (4000 range) with a shield and knockup — Quinn cannot follow or contest it, and whys[4] already says so.
audit.corrected: phases[4].side and win[4] flipped Skill -> Galio as a pair. Added real cooldowns: Blinding Assault 11s at rank 1, Justice Punch 11s at rank 1, Shield of Durand 18s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text called Blinding Assault a blind on his passive auto; Vault was credited with a knockback it does not have; Justice Punch's effect on Vault and on Behind Enemy Lines was absent.
audit.why: Riot's Q text says Valor marks an enemy and hinders its vision — a nearsight, not an attack blind. Vault leaps Quinn to max attack range away; there is no knockback on the target. Justice Punch knocks up, so it interrupts Vault mid-dash, and Behind Enemy Lines is a channel that Shield of Durand's taunt or Hero's Entrance's knockup ends.
audit.corrected: Stated the nearsight plainly, replaced the knockback with the real reposition (lands a full attack range away, outside his 275-range taunt), and put the Justice Punch / channel interaction on the page.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that his engage cancels her ultimate channel.
audit.why: Behind Enemy Lines is flagged as an interruptible channel; Galio carries two hard-CC tools.
audit.corrected: Added to the ability-interactions report line.

edits.after: Use Blinding Assault (Q) to hinder his vision and chunk him, then step up for the Harrier auto

edits.before: Land Vault (E) for the Harrier reset and knockback, then auto-reset away from his taunt range
edits.after: Land Vault (E) for the Harrier reset — it drops you an attack range away, outside his 275 taunt

edits.after: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for 11 seconds at rank 1.

edits.before: Track Galio's Justice Punch: His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. When it is down — Blind + vault re-kite.
edits.after: Justice Punch (E) knocks up: it cancels Vault mid-dash and ends Behind Enemy Lines. It is 11s at rank 1 — kite it out, then commit.

edits.before: Galio is melee and slow, so levels 1-3 are yours. Throw Blinding Assault (Q) to chunk him and blind the auto his passive empowers, then walk up for Harrier-reset autos before he can W-taunt you. Don't dump your whole combo into his W — that's the damage-reduction taunt window, so bait it, back off with your attack speed from Heightened Senses (W), and re-engage once it's down. He has no early kill threat on you; just out-range his Q poke and stack a CS lead.
edits.after: Galio is melee and slow, so levels 1-3 are yours. Throw Blinding Assault (Q) to chunk him and hinder his vision, then walk up for Harrier-reset autos before he can W-taunt you. Shield of Durand only reaches 275 and is 18s at rank 1, so bait the charge, back off on the Heightened Senses (W) attack speed, and re-engage inside that window. Justice Punch knocks up, so it cancels Vault mid-dash — never dash at him while his 11s E is up.

notes: Packet flagged wants.you[0] 'Use Blinding Assault' as a suspect name — false positive, that is Quinn's real Q name. Real errors were behavioural: Q is a nearsight (hinders vision) not an attack blind, and Vault has no knockback. Did not assert spell-shield/QSS/tenacity behaviour anywhere — the kits do not cover it.
